name: Default
shortDescription: Open source customer service and ticketing system on the Frappe Framework, with agent and customer portals, SLAs, a knowledge base, MariaDB, Redis and background workers.

alerts.message: The first deployment takes several minutes while the site is created. Then log in as Administrator with the generated ADMIN_PASSWORD, complete the setup wizard, open /helpdesk and add an email account so incoming mail becomes tickets.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
